name: glm-career
description: Full-cycle job seeking plugin bundling five skills: glm-resume-builder (generate or optimize Chinese resumes with docx/pdf/md export), glm-jd-resume-tailor (JD decomposition and targeted resume rewriting with gap analysis), glm-interview-prep (candidate-side interview preparation with categorized question banks), glm-interview-designer (interviewer-side evidence-based structured interview design) and glm-job-intent-tracker (job intent sorting and application tracking). Trigger for resume writing, JD tailoring, interview preparation and application management, serving both candidates and interviewers.

interface.shortDescription: Five career skills: resume building, JD tailoring, interview prep, interview design and application tracking.
interface.longDescription: GLM Career covers the full job-seeking cycle for both candidate and interviewer. glm-resume-builder generates or optimizes Chinese resumes with STAR rewrites, ATS keyword coverage checks and docx/pdf/md export. glm-jd-resume-tailor decomposes a target JD and rewrites the resume against it with a gap analysis. glm-interview-prep builds categorized question banks with reference answers and a printable prep handbook. glm-interview-designer works from the interviewer side: evidence-based structured interview design with scoring rubrics. glm-job-intent-tracker sorts job intents and tracks applications in a local journal. Exports land in the user's output directory; zero SDK, zero cloud calls.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the glm-career plugin skills: <写简历 / 按 JD 改简历 / 准备面试 / 设计结构化面试 / 求职意向与投递追踪>
